department: Department of Physics and Astronomy (Astronomy and Astrophysics)

deadline.value: Complete applications by December 15 (2026) for full consideration, including fellowships.
deadline.quote: All of your application materials must arrive by December 15 to receive full consideration, including for fellowships.

gre_general.value: General GRE scores are not accepted and are not considered.
gre_general.quote: General GRE scores are not accepted, and if submitted, will not be considered in the evaluation of your application.

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE scores are not accepted and are not considered.
gre_subject.quote: Physics GRE scores are not accepted, and if submitted, will not be considered in the evaluation of your application.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are for US citizens/permanent residents only; none for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, we cannot offer fee waivers to international applications under any circumstances.

supervisor.value: Apply only if you intend your primary advisor to be an astronomy-group faculty member; contact the graduate directors if unsure.
supervisor.quote: You should only apply to the Astronomy and Astrophysics Ph.D. if you intend to have your primary advisor be a faculty member in the astronomy group

funding.value: All admitted students get five years of support, usually a TA for two years then an RA.
funding.quote: we provide five years of guaranteed support to all admitted graduate students.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the page checked

notes: Separate application page from the physics PhD; same department. Department TOEFL code 61.
